name: Pets Trading
desc:
🔥 Use code "like10k" and LIKE the game for free reward!!!
👍 NEW CODE releases once the game gets 20K LIKES!!!
🎁 Special Code: "Trade2024"

How to play ? 😎
Stand on the board with the one you want to trade😁
Drop the pets 🙉😿🦊🐷🐮on the board 🤑
Jump on the green button if you want to confirm✅ 
Wanna get more pets? Use the blue button🐋➕
If decline, jump on the red button❌💃🏽

Cool pets are waiting for you, just have fun !!!
